# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser idle tycoon called **Bestie Pop-Up Tycoon**. Preserve the source mechanics exactly: start from an overlay, begin with one income generator, earn money passively at 2 per generator per second, tap the canvas for +1, and buy another generator for exactly $100 when affordable. The buy action subtracts $100 and adds one generator; below $100 the button remains disabled or blocked.

The presentation should feel like a satirical vaporwave Y2K internet-culture idle simulator: cozy desktop pets, fake browser chrome, decora kei stickers, kidcore symbols, meme copy like “real” and “bestie,” and a low-pressure one-thumb mobile UX. Use browser-native Canvas/CSS/SVG rather than heavy engines. The focal actor is the smiling pop-up pet kiosk; rewards are more pop-up pets and increasing passive drip; failure is only the soft “not enough cash yet” blocked-feedback moment.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved game is a single-page canvas idle economy. The player starts from a modal, receives one income generator, earns passive money at 2 currency per generator per second, taps the play canvas for +1 currency, and can buy another generator when money reaches 100. Buying subtracts exactly 100, spawns one new generator, updates HUD values, and shows success feedback. Trying to buy early shows blocked feedback. There is no win, loss, collision challenge, level select, or fail-state restart loop.

## Protected mechanics
- Start button begins the active loop and hides the overlay.
- Initial money is 0 and the first active generator appears on start.
- Passive income is generator count multiplied by 2 per second.
- Canvas tap gives +1 currency and creates local feedback.
- Purchase cost is 100; successful purchase subtracts 100 and adds exactly one generator.
- Buy button is disabled/inactive below 100 and enabled at or above 100.
- Resize and animation loop remain canvas-native and mobile portrait safe.

## Reinterpreted game
The mushroom grove becomes **Bestie Pop-Up Tycoon**, a cozy satirical Y2K desktop-pet idle simulator. Generators are smiling pop-up pets, money is clout-wallet cash, passive income is drip, and the buy action opens another pop-up kiosk. The fantasy changes from bioluminescent grove to vaporwave kidcore browser economy without altering scoring or progression semantics.

## Safe presentation transformation surfaces
HUD vocabulary, title, intro copy, generator drawing, background, palette, particles, feedback reels, fonts, audio labels, and mobile visual hierarchy are themable. Economy numbers, input paths, timing, purchase semantics, and update loop are protected.
